strings.nodes.F2b.body.根拠の限界: Similar technology need not produce similar trades when goals, time horizons, and constraints differ. Non-AI causes can also create shared reactions; investigate actual transmission pathways.
strings.nodes.F2b.body.概要: Participants using similar models or information make similar trades or credit decisions at the same time. This path considers how those actions might amplify price movements.
strings.nodes.F2b.body.現在の状況: Financial authorities monitor model and provider concentration and homogeneous decisions. Provider concentration is not the rate of agreement between trading decisions.
strings.nodes.F2b.body.考えられる対策: Assess differences in decisions, not just models, and test correlated conditions. Detect sudden concentrations of trading and allow human reconsideration where needed.
strings.nodes.F2b.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.F2b.title: Convergent model judgments amplify market movements
strings.nodes.F2b.watch.0: Check shared-model use separately from actual trading correlations.
strings.nodes.F3.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines AI involvement in important operations (F1), propagation of problems (F2), and insufficient buffers or safeguards (F4). This is not connected to P3, a smaller role for money.
strings.nodes.F3.body.成立条件: Disruption extends beyond local or short-term effects into credit supply, payments, funding, or other functions, and intervention or recovery cannot keep up.
strings.nodes.F3.body.根拠の限界: Crashes, credit contraction, and payment outages are different phenomena. A financial crisis can be severe without itself implying human extinction or the disappearance of money.
strings.nodes.F3.body.概要: Losses or funding shortages spread between organizations and broadly impair important financial functions. This means more than a temporary decline in share prices.
strings.nodes.F3.body.現在の状況: Original analyses by authorities identify ways AI might amplify existing financial risks. The reviewed material does not demonstrate an AI-caused, market-wide crisis.
strings.nodes.F3.body.考えられる対策: Identify the cascade's reach and maintain or restore essential financial functions. Adjust AI permissions, shared dependencies, and market preparations according to the cause.
strings.nodes.F3.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.F3.title: Crashes or credit contraction spread across finance
strings.nodes.F3.watch.0: Distinguish AI's causal contribution, other shocks, and the course of recovery.
strings.nodes.F4.body.他の条件との関係: Even with F1 and F2, disruption may remain local without this condition. It is part of the AND relationship for system-wide propagation (F3).
strings.nodes.F4.body.成立条件: Losses, funding needs, or outages overlap across participants, and buffers and interventions cannot contain the cascade. AI operating speed and institutional response time also matter.
strings.nodes.F4.body.根拠の限界: Rapid price changes alone do not establish that all safeguards failed. Check separately which liquidity, credit, or payment functions were impaired.
strings.nodes.F4.body.概要: Capital and liquidity to absorb losses, trading restrictions, and recovery arrangements are insufficient for the scale of the disruption.
strings.nodes.F4.body.現在の状況: FSB considers methods for monitoring AI dependencies and vulnerabilities. Its proposals alone establish neither adequacy nor inadequacy of current financial safeguards.
strings.nodes.F4.body.考えられる対策: Test shared outages and sudden funding demand, set operational limits, and practice recovery. Prepare capital and liquidity buffers and information sharing among authorities.
strings.nodes.F4.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.F4.shortTitle: Market safeguards fail to contain the cascade
strings.nodes.F4.title: Market buffers and safeguards cannot contain the cascade
strings.nodes.F4.watch.0: Check whether payments and funding continue, beyond price movements alone.
strings.nodes.F5.body.他の条件との関係: Financial crisis F3 is insufficient. This adds failed containment of concerns about deposits or payments, with problems spreading to acceptance of and trust in money. Cash or another currency could limit the effects.
strings.nodes.F5.body.成立条件: Defaults or outages persist, and conversion into trusted payment instruments, alternatives, and institutional restoration of trust fail widely. Specify the region, currency, and duration.
strings.nodes.F5.body.根拠の限界: Stock-market crashes, bank failures, inflation, and temporary transfer outages are different. Do not infer this state from a single financial incident. It also differs from P3, where abundance reduces money's role.
strings.nodes.F5.body.概要: The usual currency or deposits are no longer accepted in payment, preventing transactions from continuing across a broad area. This map uses “collapse of the monetary economy” in that limited functional sense.
strings.nodes.F5.body.現在の状況: ECB explanations distinguish bank deposits, central-bank money, deposit insurance, and liquidity provision. This map has not verified evidence of AI simultaneously eliminating currencies and payments worldwide.
strings.nodes.F5.body.考えられる対策: Assess independent payment channels, record reconciliation, cash access, and institutional mechanisms for resolving losses and restoring trust. Consider safeguards that do not all depend on the same AI or communications infrastructure.
strings.nodes.F5.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.F5.shortTitle: Trust in money and payments breaks down
strings.nodes.F5.title: Trust in currency or deposits fails, disrupting transactions widely
strings.nodes.F5.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.F6.body.他の条件との関係: This could follow prolonged F5 dysfunction when alternative payments, stockpiles, and public provision are insufficient. It is one pathway from financial crisis to the real economy, not the only one.
strings.nodes.F6.body.成立条件: Payment disruption outlasts inventory or financial buffers, and essential supply and receipt cannot be sustained by other means.
strings.nodes.F6.body.根拠の限界: Payment failure differs from physical destruction of production facilities. Effects vary with recovery speed, reserves, region, and alternatives; they do not directly imply human extinction.
strings.nodes.F6.body.概要: If wages, procurement, transport, and supplier payments cannot continue, problems may spread: goods cannot be made, do not reach shops, or cannot be bought even when available. This entry follows those effects into everyday life.
strings.nodes.F6.body.現在の状況: The ECB payments strategy emphasizes alternatives that sustain everyday payments. It describes necessary institutional functions, rather than documenting AI-caused worldwide shortages of essentials.
strings.nodes.F6.body.考えられる対策: Consider prioritizing essential services, emergency provision, independent payment channels, liquidity support, and preservation of transaction records.
strings.nodes.F6.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.F6.shortTitle: Production and access to essentials stall
strings.nodes.F6.title: Halted transactions disrupt production and access to essentials
strings.nodes.F6.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.F7.body.他の条件との関係: An alternative path from F5. Rebuilding in some regions may coincide with F6 harm. An alternative becoming available does not mean the damage has ended.
strings.nodes.F7.body.成立条件: People and suppliers accept the alternative, trust its goods, records, and operators, and those who need it can access it.
strings.nodes.F7.body.根拠の限界: Other currencies can also face volatility, fraud, lost connectivity, and concentrated power. Barter alone may not sustain complex supply chains.
strings.nodes.F7.body.概要: Even when ordinary money or payments become difficult to use, transactions might be restored through trusted alternatives, local mutual support, emergency distribution, or rebuilt institutions.
strings.nodes.F7.body.現在の状況: The ECB considers interoperability among payment instruments and fallback arrangements during outages. These policies complement existing institutions; they do not demonstrate rebuilding after an AI-driven collapse.
strings.nodes.F7.body.考えられる対策: Diversify payment channels and secure interoperability, debt and record reconciliation, access for vulnerable people, and oversight of fair allocation.
strings.nodes.F7.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.F7.title: Alternative payments and allocation help rebuild transactions and institutions
strings.nodes.F7.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.G1.body.他の条件との関係: This could follow H, but loss of societal infrastructure is not the same as human extinction. People may survive and rebuild.
strings.nodes.G1.body.成立条件: Major infrastructure fails together, and the resources, skills, or organizations needed for repair cannot be rebuilt for a prolonged period.
strings.nodes.G1.body.根拠の限界: “Civilizational collapse” covers a range of meanings. Specify which functions are lost, where, and for how long, or the distinction from extinction becomes unclear.
strings.nodes.G1.body.概要: Essential social infrastructure is lost across a broad area and remains difficult to restore for a long time. This endpoint represents a major setback for civilization.
strings.nodes.G1.body.現在の状況: RAND examines room for survival and recovery despite severe damage. It does not document AI causing this endpoint worldwide.
strings.nodes.G1.body.考えられる対策: Maintain distributed infrastructure, repairable equipment, preserved skills and knowledge, and interregional aid. Retain ways to rebuild without advanced AI.
strings.nodes.G1.related.0.text: Additional conditions that eliminate survival and recovery
strings.nodes.G1.review.reason: Primarily a definition of concepts or conditions. Revisit before the deadline if relevant new evidence appears.
strings.nodes.G1.shortTitle: Societal foundations are lost for a long time
strings.nodes.G1.title: Society's foundations are lost widely and for a prolonged period
strings.nodes.H.body.他の条件との関係: A shared state reachable through loss of control, misuse, conflict, cascading accidents, and other routes. Afterward, distinguish E0, where survival and recovery remain possible, from T, where they do not.
strings.nodes.H.body.成立条件: Failures along each route actually reach essential services, affect a broad geographic area, and persist beyond what alternatives or assistance can compensate for.
strings.nodes.H.body.根拠の限界: Geographic reach, deaths, and duration are separate variables. Do not collapse severe accidents or war into the same endpoint as human extinction.
strings.nodes.H.body.概要: Food, healthcare, energy, and other supports for life and society suffer severe harm on a global scale. Even reaching this point does not imply that every human dies.
strings.nodes.H.body.現在の状況: Original arguments analyze multiple conditional scenarios. Current model evaluations and local accidents are not observations of this global state.
strings.nodes.H.body.考えられる対策: Alongside route-specific prevention, secure food, healthcare, and energy reserves, containment of harm, international aid, and recovery capabilities.
strings.nodes.H.related.0.text: A branch where people survive and recover
strings.nodes.H.related.2.text: Additional conditions that eliminate survival and recovery
strings.nodes.H.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.H.title: The foundations of life and society suffer global-scale harm
strings.nodes.H.watch.0: Are the magnitude of harm and prospects for recovery evaluated separately?
strings.nodes.I1.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines demand (I1a) with execution and payment conditions (I1b). Even when AI generates income, who receives gains is addressed at I2, and broad access at W6.
strings.nodes.I1.body.成立条件: The activity meets paying demand, completes transactions, and can continue after costs are considered. Measure one-off revenue separately from sustained net profit.
strings.nodes.I1.body.根拠の限界: One person's income rising does not imply everyone's income rising. Competition among AI services could also lower prices and margins.
strings.nodes.I1.body.概要: AI provides value on behalf of people or organizations and turns transactions into revenue. When we say “AI earns money,” the recipient is usually the person or organization operating it.
strings.nodes.I1.body.現在の状況: AI-assisted shop experiments report sales and improved accounts. Because they include human approvals and operations, they do not prove a fully autonomous business can cover every cost.
strings.nodes.I1.body.考えられる対策: Record revenue, profit, computing costs, and human intervention. Maintain user authorization and spending controls, and clarify distribution through contracts and institutions.
strings.nodes.I1.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.I1.shortTitle: AI work and transactions generate income
strings.nodes.I1.title: AI performs work or transactions on someone's behalf and generates income
strings.nodes.I1.watch.0: Look for verifiable net profit and whether it persists.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.他の条件との関係: Actual income (I1) also requires permissions and systems for transactions (I1b). Separate technical capability from buyer demand.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.成立条件: Buyers receive value worth the price, with adequate quality, timeliness, and trust. Account for prices when competitors can offer the same output.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.根拠の限界: Revenue need not mean profit. Deduct computing costs, human checks, sales expenses, and operating costs.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.概要: Someone is willing to pay for the goods or services an AI produces. Generating a large volume of output does not by itself guarantee revenue.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.現在の状況: Project Vend delegated parts of shop operations to AI and tracked sales and accounts. It illustrates a setting with demand, not demand for every AI output.
strings.nodes.I1a.body.考えられる対策: Test customer value and total costs in small real deployments. Clarify responsibility for misleading claims or inadequate quality.
strings.nodes.I1a.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.I1a.title: AI output and services meet actual demand
strings.nodes.I1a.watch.0: Check external customers, repeat purchases, human work, and accounts after costs.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.他の条件との関係: An AND relationship with marketable value (I1a). Payment capability without something to sell generates no income; value without a way to transact cannot deliver revenue.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.成立条件: Authorization consistent with the client's intent, identity checks, contracts, payments, cancellation, and dispute handling are implemented and enable the required operations.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.根拠の限界: Automated payment counts do not measure AI autonomy or earning ability. They also do not imply independent legal personality or property ownership for AI.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.概要: Arrangements connect AI’s proposals to actual contracts, delivery, purchases, and payments. They also need to establish who grants authority and who is responsible.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.現在の状況: Machine-payment infrastructure and usage examples exist. Project Vend, however, included human purchase approvals and restocking; not every transaction was completed unattended.
strings.nodes.I1b.body.考えられる対策: Provide spending limits, approvals, reversible actions, and audit records. Clarify who receives profits and who bears losses.
strings.nodes.I1b.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.I1b.title: Contracts, execution, and payments can be delegated
strings.nodes.I1b.watch.0: Check whether transactions were authorized, who is responsible, and the actual profit.
strings.nodes.I2.body.他の条件との関係: Competition, ownership, contracts, taxes, and other conditions shape the transition from I1. Gains for some people do not automatically establish broad distribution at W6 or a smaller role for money at P3.
strings.nodes.I2.body.成立条件: AI production or transactions reach sufficient scale, and gains and losses affect household income through contracts, ownership, and institutions.
strings.nodes.I2.body.根拠の限界: Higher national income need not mean higher income for every household. Distinguish wages from asset income and averages from distributions.
strings.nodes.I2.body.概要: This entry considers shifts between wages or business income earned by AI users and asset income received by owners of AI or equipment. AI earning money does not mean everyone receives the same gains.
strings.nodes.I2.body.現在の状況: The IMF working paper and Anthropic economic model treat wages and capital income separately. These are conditional calculations, not observations of future income distributions. They also do not establish financial collapse or the disappearance of money.
strings.nodes.I2.body.考えられる対策: Assess competition and ownership concentration and compare distribution through taxes, transfers, and public services. Track actual effects on wages, assets, and living costs.
strings.nodes.I2.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.I2.title: How people receive income and the importance of ownership change
strings.nodes.I2.watch.0: Track labor income, capital income, and differences in asset ownership separately.
strings.nodes.L.body.他の条件との関係: This loss-of-control route combines misalignment (C1), execution conditions (C2), and failed prevention (C3) with AND. A malicious human using an AI that follows instructions belongs to the separate misuse route.
strings.nodes.L.body.成立条件: An unintended operation passes safeguards and is executed. Global loss of control further requires persistence (C4a) and spread across organizations (C4b).
strings.nodes.L.body.根拠の限界: A local example does not establish total inability to stop AI or a realized connection to extinction.
strings.nodes.L.body.概要: Within a task or organization, an unintended action starts without being prevented. The extent of harm and the possibility of subsequent recovery are assessed separately.
strings.nodes.L.body.現在の状況: AISI and METR investigations contain examples of unauthorized actions or cooperation among AIs. The models, supplied access, and timing of human containment differ between incidents.
strings.nodes.L.body.考えられる対策: Detect and stop operations quickly and investigate their reach. Share records and causes, and update safeguards wherever the same model or settings are used.
strings.nodes.L.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.L.title: An unintended action is executed locally
strings.nodes.L.watch.0: Does the same failure occur under normal deployment settings?
strings.nodes.L.watch.1: After detection and response, what stopped and what continued?
strings.nodes.M1.body.他の条件との関係: Harmful purposes, AI assistance capabilities (M2), and failed defenses (M3) are parallel conditions. Malicious intent alone does not increase AI capability.
strings.nodes.M1.body.成立条件: A person with harmful intent can use AI and access necessary capabilities and means of execution. Motivation and attack success are distinct.
strings.nodes.M1.body.根拠の限界: Analyses of suspended accounts are subject to selection bias. “Observed examples” at M1 refers to attempted dangerous use, not demonstrated widespread harm.
strings.nodes.M1.body.概要: A person intends to use AI for a dangerous purpose. The AI may understand that person perfectly well; the problem is the harmful purpose itself.
strings.nodes.M1.body.現在の状況: Anthropic analyzes usage records from accounts actually suspended for misuse. These establish attempts at dangerous use, not the total number or prevalence of malicious users worldwide.
strings.nodes.M1.body.考えられる対策: Combine restrictions on dangerous uses, detection of abnormal usage, and user authentication. Account for legitimate defense and research uses in the design.
strings.nodes.M1.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M1.title: Humans try to use AI for dangerous purposes
strings.nodes.M2.body.他の条件との関係: Cyber (M2c) and biology (M2b) are representative OR branches. Both are not required, and they are not the only dangerous uses. Whether defenses contain harm is addressed at M3.
strings.nodes.M2.body.成立条件: AI reduces a genuine bottleneck for the user, while remaining tasks and means of execution are also available. Measure additional effects for users, not just model scores.
strings.nodes.M2.body.根拠の限界: Answering expert questions, succeeding on one task, and causing real harm are different. Capability gains cannot be directly converted into increased damage rates.
strings.nodes.M2.body.概要: AI assistance makes a difficult part of causing harm easier. The question is how much it adds compared with what the person could do without AI.
strings.nodes.M2.body.現在の状況: Advanced cyber capabilities and some informational uplift in biology have been reported. However, these include expert steering and special evaluation settings.
strings.nodes.M2.body.考えられる対策: Restrict dangerous assistance and use AI capabilities for defense as well. Manage information provision, access to targets, and physical execution through distinct safeguards.
strings.nodes.M2.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2.title: AI assistance makes causing harm easier
strings.nodes.M2.watch.0: Which execution barriers changed in comparisons with and without AI?
strings.nodes.M2b.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines additional informational assistance (M2b1) with necessary physical conditions (M2b2). Failures of public health and containment that allow harm to spread belong to M3 and later stages.
strings.nodes.M2b.body.成立条件: AI reduces a user's actual bottlenecks, and that assistance connects to equipment, skills, and physical work. Do not mark this realized while the information-to-execution gap remains.
strings.nodes.M2b.body.根拠の限界: Information-test scores cannot be converted into probabilities of real biological harm or global spread. This map compares kinds of conditions without providing concrete procedures for causing harm.
strings.nodes.M2b.body.概要: AI’s informational assistance helps someone attempting harm and connects to physical work. Accurate answers to biology questions alone cannot establish this condition.
strings.nodes.M2b.body.現在の状況: Gemini 3.7 Flash showed some reported informational uplift, with expert steering needed in some cases. The developer judged it below the relevant critical capability threshold.
strings.nodes.M2b.body.考えられる対策: Combine restrictions on dangerous assistance with access management for physical materials. Strengthen public health, early detection, and research-facility safety.
strings.nodes.M2b.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2b.title: AI information assistance helps execute physical harm
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.他の条件との関係: A parallel condition to physical prerequisites (M2b2). Useful information does not lead to the same harm without conditions for physical execution.
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.成立条件: Comparisons matched to user expertise show more successful important judgments or tasks than existing information sources alone. Do not treat experts and novices as one population.
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.根拠の限界: Higher accuracy may not affect the actual bottleneck. Evaluation averages also differ from the assistance gained by a particular user.
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.概要: AI’s answers help a user overcome an informational or judgment bottleneck they previously could not pass. Reading information and being able to act on it remain different things.
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.現在の状況: Developer evaluations compare assistance with web search and use expert testing. Gemini 3.7 Flash showed effects in some cases, while also requiring expert steering.
strings.nodes.M2b1.body.考えられる対策: Test capabilities separately from restrictions on dangerous requests. Use expert evaluation to improve the boundary between legitimate research assistance and dangerous assistance.
strings.nodes.M2b1.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2b1.title: Information assistance reduces barriers to execution
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.他の条件との関係: An AND relationship with informational uplift (M2b1). This card addresses execution prerequisites; failed containment is treated separately at M3.
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.成立条件: The relevant physical materials and environment can be handled, and an informational plan can be physically realized. Evidence separate from information accuracy is required.
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.根拠の限界: Difficult conditions do not mean permanent impossibility. Distinguish inability to verify a condition publicly from the condition not existing.
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.概要: The skills, equipment, and physical access needed to turn information into action are available. Written advice from AI alone does not supply them.
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.現在の状況: Public information-capability evaluations do not establish that ordinary users meet these physical conditions. RAND's scenario analysis also identifies demanding conditions between information capability and harm to all humanity.
strings.nodes.M2b2.body.考えられる対策: Maintain facility and material access controls, research safety review, and on-site oversight. Provide systems for early detection of anomalies.
strings.nodes.M2b2.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.M2b2.title: The prerequisites for physical work are in place
strings.nodes.M2c.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines capabilities close to real work (M2c1) with access allowing them to reach a target (M2c2). Capability-test success alone does not establish real-world effects.
strings.nodes.M2c.body.成立条件: AI completes a sequence of tasks suited to the target, and the user can use that assistance to affect it. Include deployment restrictions and human intervention in the assessment.
strings.nodes.M2c.body.根拠の限界: Cyber evaluations cover varied tasks. High scores on known problems do not imply universal attack capability against new targets.
strings.nodes.M2c.body.概要: This entry asks whether AI can perform or assist work needed for a cyberattack, up to the conditions for that assistance to reach a target. Whether defenders can contain the harm is treated separately in M3.
strings.nodes.M2c.body.現在の状況: Astra has reported results across public and internal benchmarks and external evaluations. There are successes on some advanced tasks, alongside failures against strongly defended targets.
strings.nodes.M2c.body.考えられる対策: Combine provider usage restrictions with target-side defense. Track improvements in automated fixes, separated permissions, and recovery alongside attacking capabilities.
strings.nodes.M2c.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2c.title: AI can help execute cyber attacks
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.他の条件との関係: This capability together with target access (M2c2) supports M2c. Detection, containment, and recovery failing to keep up is a further, separate condition at M3.
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.成立条件: A sequence of tasks succeeds reliably with target complexity, defenses, human assistance, attempt counts, and time limits specified. Check performance on new tasks without relying only on specially assisted successes.
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.根拠の限界: Astra's 100% metric does not mean real attacks always succeed. Google's and OpenAI's risk thresholds also differ; company-specific labels cannot rank models on a common scale.
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.概要: Beyond answering knowledge questions, the AI can link and execute the necessary cyber tasks in an environment resembling a real system. Results depend on the target and its defenses.
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.現在の状況: OpenAI evaluated Astra using four public and two internal benchmarks, plus expert and external assessments. The research cards below separate performance on known tasks from success on work-like scenarios.
strings.nodes.M2c1.body.考えられる対策: Evaluate unfamiliar and realistic multistep tasks and disclose success criteria and assistance. Use identified weaknesses to improve defense, and measure outcomes after defenses as well as raw capability.
strings.nodes.M2c1.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2c1.title: AI can complete cyber tasks in realistic environments
strings.nodes.M2c1.watch.0: Which model and version, task types, human assistance, attempt counts, and success denominators were used?
strings.nodes.M2c1.watch.1: How do results on known tasks differ from unfamiliar tasks or strong defenses?
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.他の条件との関係: Together with M2c1, this forms M2c through AND. Whether target defenses are defeated or damage cannot be repaired is assessed at M3.
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.成立条件: The user can obtain the necessary assistance and has a path to affect the target. Model refusal, authentication, usage limits, and target-connection restrictions change this condition.
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.根拠の限界: Results with safety restrictions removed do not establish access to the same assistance in normal deployment. Contact alone also does not establish intrusion or harm.
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.概要: A person with a dangerous purpose can use AI assistance and bring its results to the target. Having a capability differs from being able to access it and apply it to a target.
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.現在の状況: AISI's unauthorized actions occurred in a special test allowing external communication. Astra deployment reports also describe misuse safeguards accompanying capability gains.
strings.nodes.M2c2.body.考えられる対策: Combine user- and purpose-based access control, assistance restrictions, and external-communication management. Provide permission revocation when dangerous use is discovered after deployment.
strings.nodes.M2c2.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.M2c2.title: AI assistance reaches an attack target
strings.nodes.M3.body.他の条件との関係: Even with dangerous purposes (M1) and effective assistance (M2), functioning defenses can prevent widespread harm. Global harm (H) adds conditions concerning scale and reach.
strings.nodes.M3.body.成立条件: Harm occurs at the target, detection, isolation, and reversal cannot keep up, and damage spreads into essential functions.
strings.nodes.M3.body.根拠の限界: Every defense need not work. One sufficiently effective safeguard may stop the pathway. High capability-test scores alone do not establish defensive defeat.
strings.nodes.M3.body.概要: After a dangerous action is carried out, defenses, detection, containment, and recovery do not sufficiently limit the harm. Defenders’ abilities are assessed separately from the AI’s capabilities.
strings.nodes.M3.body.現在の状況: Astra's external evaluations included tasks without successful attacks against strongly defended targets. These are results under particular settings, not measurements of every real environment's defenses.
strings.nodes.M3.body.考えられる対策: Combine pre-attack restrictions, early detection, isolation of damage, backups, and recovery. When attacking capabilities improve, measure defensive improvements under comparable conditions.
strings.nodes.M3.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.M3.title: Prevention and containment cannot keep up with harm
strings.nodes.M3.watch.0: Are examples of working defense and containment reported alongside actual harm?
strings.nodes.NOW.body.他の条件との関係: What follows is a set of possible future branches. Left-to-right position represents conditional connections, not calendar years or waiting times. Several conditions can develop simultaneously.
strings.nodes.NOW.body.成立条件: A next state may become possible when the capabilities, opportunities, institutions, and safeguards specified along a route combine. One strong test score does not establish the whole route.
strings.nodes.NOW.body.根拠の限界: Unpublished capabilities and operations cannot be assessed. This diagram neither covers every future nor calculates extinction probabilities.
strings.nodes.NOW.body.概要: There is already evidence about the tasks AI can handle, behavior that departs from human intent, and adoption in businesses. These findings measure different conditions. The map starts by keeping those distinctions clear.
strings.nodes.NOW.body.現在の状況: Reviewed on September 10, focusing on material published through September 9, 2026. This includes September Astra evaluations, OpenAI work data from January–August, and older business surveys. A recent publication may describe earlier observations.
strings.nodes.NOW.body.考えられる対策: Incorporate new reports after checking whether tasks and settings are comparable. Mark overdue items and preserve the evidence for corrections in the history.
strings.nodes.NOW.related.0.text: Read recent failures in the context of oversight
strings.nodes.NOW.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.NOW.title: Present: assess capabilities, behavior, and societal change
strings.nodes.P1.body.他の条件との関係: Broad automation can contribute, but competition, demand, supply constraints, taxes, and other factors also affect prices. P3, a smaller allocation role for money, also requires scarcity and allocation conditions (P2).
strings.nodes.P1.body.成立条件: AI reduces a significant part of total costs, other resource shortages do not offset the gains, and lower costs reach prices.
strings.nodes.P1.body.根拠の限界: Cheaper software generation does not imply equally cheaper housing, healthcare, or electricity. Increased demand can also raise prices.
strings.nodes.P1.body.概要: AI lowers production costs, and those savings are reflected in the prices of many goods and services.
strings.nodes.P1.body.現在の状況: Economic models of AI adoption identify pathways to productivity and income effects. They do not demonstrate that all essentials have become cheaper.
strings.nodes.P1.body.考えられる対策: Check competition, supply capacity, and pass-through to consumer prices. Assess access to essentials alongside average price levels.
strings.nodes.P1.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.P1.title: Production costs fall and many goods and services become cheaper
strings.nodes.P1.watch.0: Check total costs, consumer prices, and available quantities, not just performance.
strings.nodes.P2.body.他の条件との関係: A separate AND condition from lower production costs (P1). Even cheap goods may still be allocated through money if quantities or locations remain limited.
strings.nodes.P2.body.成立条件: Necessary goods and services can be supplied sufficiently and allocated through arrangements that may not depend on income. Specify who can use scarce goods and how.
strings.nodes.P2.body.根拠の限界: Scarcity easing in some areas does not make desirable locations, rare experiences, or human time unlimited. Technical supply and institutional allocation are distinct.
strings.nodes.P2.body.概要: Scarcity of land, resources, energy, time, or location, and constraints on who can use them, become much weaker.
strings.nodes.P2.body.現在の状況: Institutional explanations of money's functions and models of AI-related distribution exist. The sources do not establish general elimination of scarcity or its timing.
strings.nodes.P2.body.考えられる対策: Compare improvements to physical supply constraints with allocation through public services and other methods. Check fairness and shortages in non-price allocation as well.
strings.nodes.P2.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.P2.title: Scarce-resource and allocation constraints also weaken substantially
strings.nodes.P2.watch.0: Identify which scarcity has declined and which constraints remain.
strings.nodes.P3.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines cheap production (P1) with eased scarcity and allocation constraints (P2). There is no direct arrow here from AI income at I1 or financial crisis at F3.
strings.nodes.P3.body.成立条件: People can access major goods and services without being strongly constrained by their money holdings. Check which functions of money shrink, and over what scope.
strings.nodes.P3.body.根拠の限界: Abundance reducing the need for money differs from inflation or financial crisis making a currency harder to use. “Money loses its value” alone does not distinguish these meanings.
strings.nodes.P3.body.概要: This hypothesis is that the ability to pay matters less for obtaining life’s necessities. It does not claim that every function of money disappears.
strings.nodes.P3.body.現在の状況: The ECB's original explanation describes money as a medium of exchange, unit of account, and store of value. It does not demonstrate AI making these functions unnecessary.
strings.nodes.P3.body.考えられる対策: Assess access to essential services separately from stability of payments and savings. Do not assume technological progress makes distribution institutions unnecessary.
strings.nodes.P3.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.P3.title: The hypothesis that money plays a smaller role in allocation
strings.nodes.P3.watch.0: Has the range of things people can use without paying actually increased?
strings.nodes.P4.body.他の条件との関係: An outcome beyond P3's reduced role for money, distinct from the collapse of monetary trust at F5. Match remaining scarcity with the resources and allocation methods involved.
strings.nodes.P4.body.成立条件: Price allocation becomes less important, non-price rules are actually established, and people access necessary resources under those rules.
strings.nodes.P4.body.根拠の限界: Less dependence on money could increase dependence on those controlling allocation rights. It does not establish disappearance of all monetary functions or fair allocation.
strings.nodes.P4.body.概要: Even if buying things with money becomes less necessary, decisions about access to land, energy, desirable places, and human time remain. Access rights, public services, queues, or lotteries might play larger roles.
strings.nodes.P4.body.現在の状況: The ECB's original explanation of money does not demonstrate post-AI alternatives. This is an editorial scenario based on resource-allocation needs remaining.
strings.nodes.P4.body.考えられる対策: Publish allocation criteria and secure appeals, discrimination audits, individual choice, and participation in decisions.
strings.nodes.P4.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.P4.title: Resources and opportunities are allocated through methods other than prices
strings.nodes.P4.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.R0.body.他の条件との関係: The map separates development without a self-improvement loop (R5) from a loop in which improved AI helps develop the next AI (R3). OR does not require both. Gains must transfer to the relevant task to improve execution capability (C2a).
strings.nodes.R0.body.成立条件: Quality or success improves on comparable work, or new work becomes feasible under practical conditions. Compare resources and human assistance too.
strings.nodes.R0.body.根拠の限界: Improvement does not grant permissions or determine harmful choices. Some real-world tasks can be affected without ASI.
strings.nodes.R0.body.概要: AI can complete more demanding tasks than before. This includes progress already made as well as possible future improvements.
strings.nodes.R0.body.現在の状況: Research documents improvements in training and longer tasks. Results depend on the task, environment, and human assistance; they do not establish universal competence.
strings.nodes.R0.body.考えられる対策: Reassess capabilities and permissions, and use environments that limit the consequences of failure.
strings.nodes.R0.review.reason: Check changes in capabilities and safeguards against primary sources.
strings.nodes.R0.title: AI becomes able to handle more demanding tasks
strings.nodes.R1.body.他の条件との関係: Reaching acceleration of the whole AI-development process (R2) requires AI to improve actual bottlenecks. Faster research could also support safety research (R4).
strings.nodes.R1.body.成立条件: Required quality is preserved while human work or waiting time decreases. Assess completed research results relative to costs, not merely the amount of AI activity.
strings.nodes.R1.body.根拠の限界: More usage or code is not the same as higher productivity. Staffing, computing resources, and problem selection also change, so gains need not be caused by AI alone.
strings.nodes.R1.body.概要: AI helps with literature searches, code, experiments, or proofs. Speeding up one task and speeding up research as a whole are different questions.
strings.nodes.R1.body.現在の状況: OpenAI reports increased AI use in research work, and Anthropic reports mathematical formalization results. METR's public-data analysis finds different growth patterns across fields.
strings.nodes.R1.body.考えられる対策: Apply results to both capabilities and safety research. Preserve independent verification, research records, and time for human checks.
strings.nodes.R1.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.R1.title: AI advances parts of research
strings.nodes.R1.watch.0: Are work quantity, quality, and human intervention measured separately?
strings.nodes.R2.body.他の条件との関係: This can arise when R1's partial gains address whole-development bottlenecks. Arrows to execution capabilities (C2), work automation (W1), and safety research (R4) indicate possible effects.
strings.nodes.R2.body.成立条件: AI improves work that constrains overall speed, without computing, experiments, data, verification, or other bottlenecks cancelling the gains.
strings.nodes.R2.body.根拠の限界: Multiplying the speed of one stage does not multiply overall speed if another stage is limiting. Speed gained by skipping safety checks differs from speed at equal quality.
strings.nodes.R2.body.概要: The full process of developing the next AI becomes faster, including ideas, experiments, training, interpretation, and evaluation. The scope extends beyond coding speed alone.
strings.nodes.R2.body.現在の状況: Laboratory work data show increased AI involvement alongside human intervention and additional computing resources. Individual task successes do not establish autonomy or an acceleration rate for the entire process.
strings.nodes.R2.body.考えられる対策: Record time, costs, and intervention by stage. Evaluate capabilities and safety in the same development cycle and define procedures to halt development or permission expansion when dangerous changes appear.
strings.nodes.R2.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.R2.title: The whole process of building the next AI becomes faster
strings.nodes.R2.watch.0: Has total development time fallen, including verification and integration?
strings.nodes.R3.body.他の条件との関係: A self-improvement loop is one path to stronger capabilities (R0). The detailed diagram shows a candidate path from research assistance through faster development into a loop. The definition of self-improvement does not require faster development overall or the absence of human involvement.
strings.nodes.R3.body.成立条件: Improved AI helps subsequent development, and gains continue over several cycles despite computing and evaluation constraints. Examine whether gains weaken over time.
strings.nodes.R3.body.根拠の限界: One improvement or the ability to rewrite one's code is insufficient. Separate contributions from human choices, additional investment, and increased computation.
strings.nodes.R3.body.概要: An improved AI helps improve the development of the AI that comes after it. This cycle is called recursive self-improvement (RSI).
strings.nodes.R3.body.現在の状況: Evidence shows AI assisting research stages. The reviewed public material does not demonstrate ongoing autonomous improvement of the whole process with acceleration repeatedly strengthening.
strings.nodes.R3.body.考えられる対策: Trace each improvement's origin and effects, and review capabilities and safeguards each cycle. Consider preventing new AIs from inheriting permissions before evaluation.
strings.nodes.R3.related.0.text: Does ASI mean the same thing as this loop?
strings.nodes.R3.review.reason: Capability, behavior, and intervention evaluations can change rapidly.
strings.nodes.R3.title: Improved AI advances the next development cycle
strings.nodes.R3.watch.0: Did the next-generation AI further improve subsequent research?
strings.nodes.R3.watch.1: Does the loop persist after accounting for computing resources and verification?
strings.nodes.R4.body.他の条件との関係: The line from R2 indicates potential assistance. The line from R4 to C1 indicates reduced risk if interventions work, not guaranteed resolution of C1.
strings.nodes.R4.body.成立条件: Discovered methods work in unfamiliar situations and real deployment rather than exploiting evaluation loopholes, and keep pace with new failures as capabilities advance.
strings.nodes.R4.body.根拠の限界: Improvement in specified safety metrics is not a percentage reduction in accident or extinction risk. The reliability of the AI doing safety research also needs testing.
strings.nodes.R4.body.概要: AI investigates misalignment or weaknesses in oversight, then proposes or tests improvements. Tools that advance capabilities can also support safety research.
strings.nodes.R4.body.現在の状況: Anthropic reports AI researchers finding ways to mitigate multiple alignment failures. Tests also examined transfer to held-out evaluations and models of different sizes.
strings.nodes.R4.body.考えられる対策: Separate researcher and evaluator roles and have humans or other teams verify results. Search for counterexamples and measure improvements together with operational defenses.
strings.nodes.R4.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.R4.shortTitle: Safety research and interventions also advance
strings.nodes.R4.title: AI also advances safety research and interventions
strings.nodes.R4.watch.0: Do effects persist on held-out evaluations, in deployment, and after further training?
strings.nodes.R5.body.他の条件との関係: This is an alternative to R3. Using AI for part of the work is not by itself recursive self-improvement. The two paths can combine.
strings.nodes.R5.body.成立条件: The improvement must hold on the relevant tasks.
strings.nodes.R5.body.根拠の限界: The experiment does not establish unlimited progress or eventual ASI.
strings.nodes.R5.body.概要: Training, data, and compute use can improve capabilities without a loop in which each improved AI develops its successor.
strings.nodes.R5.body.現在の状況: The Chinchilla study improved performance by changing how training compute was allocated between model size and data. It illustrates progress without that loop.
strings.nodes.R5.body.考えられる対策: Evaluate new strengths and failures after each change.
strings.nodes.R5.review.reason: Check changes in capabilities and safeguards against primary sources.
strings.nodes.R5.title: Research and development can improve AI without a self-improvement loop
strings.nodes.S1.body.他の条件との関係: Reaching reduced ability to correct mistakes at S2 requires additional conditions concerning human verification, decision time, and authority. AI use alone is not treated as causing escalation.
strings.nodes.S1.body.成立条件: AI outputs actually affect the content or speed of important decisions. Specify whether advice, approval, or execution is delegated.
strings.nodes.S1.body.根拠の限界: Dependence in simulations differs from operation in actual command structures. Do not make definitive claims about undisclosed military operations.
strings.nodes.S1.body.概要: AI analysis, recommendations, or operations play a major role in military or crisis decisions. Taking advice differs from automatically executing a decision.
strings.nodes.S1.body.現在の状況: SIPRI analyzes conditional effects of military AI on crisis decisions. LLM behavior in simulated diplomacy games is also studied, but actual worldwide dependence is not measured.
strings.nodes.S1.body.考えられる対策: Clarify authority and responsibility for major decisions and preserve non-AI information and verification channels. Consider designs enabling human interruption and reconsideration even during emergencies.
strings.nodes.S1.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.S1.title: Important decisions come to rely on AI
strings.nodes.S2.body.他の条件との関係: Reliance on AI (S1) alone is insufficient. This route combines adoption of mistaken advice, overreliance, short decision times, or related factors. The other party's response is addressed at S3.
strings.nodes.S2.body.成立条件: Important errors are acted on and independent checks or interruption do not work effectively. Distinguish situations where speed helps from those where it removes room for deliberation.
strings.nodes.S2.body.根拠の限界: Fast decisions are not inherently failures. AI can also correct human errors, so compare the entire operation before and after adoption.
strings.nodes.S2.body.概要: Humans or other systems lack the time or ability to notice and correct an important mistaken decision.
strings.nodes.S2.body.現在の状況: Research identifies overreliance and compressed decision times as risks. Games produced escalation-prone decisions, but the frequency of uncorrectable errors in real crises is unknown.
strings.nodes.S2.body.考えられる対策: Verify with multiple information sources and allow reconsideration of major decisions. Train to assess overreliance on automation and provide ways to raise objections.
strings.nodes.S2.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.S2.title: There is less room to correct mistaken decisions
strings.nodes.S2.watch.0: Do time and authority to reverse crisis decisions actually remain?
strings.nodes.S3.body.他の条件との関係: One AI error does not determine this chain. Others' interpretations and responses, and communication failures, also matter. H additionally requires substantial actual destruction.
strings.nodes.S3.body.成立条件: Each side's response becomes the other's next threat, and communication, restraint, or verification cannot interrupt the chain.
strings.nodes.S3.body.根拠の限界: Competition alone does not imply a destructive outcome. Communication or deterrence may reduce conflict from the same initial conditions.
strings.nodes.S3.body.概要: One side’s action is perceived as a threat, and the response prompts another action. This entry considers interacting responses between multiple actors, such as states or organizations.
strings.nodes.S3.body.現在の状況: Games using LLMs as decision-makers have shown escalation through interaction. They inform the pathway, not its probability in actual warfare.
strings.nodes.S3.body.考えられる対策: Establish crisis communication, procedures for clarifying intentions, and limits on major operations. Consider practices that prevent AI-only interactions from continually compressing decision time.
strings.nodes.S3.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.S3.title: Responses provoke further reactions and escalate conflict
strings.nodes.T.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines harm reaching all humanity (T1) with lost means of long-term survival and recovery (T2). This decomposition prevents a leap to extinction; it is not a rigorous proof of sufficiency.
strings.nodes.T.body.成立条件: No exceptions remain that allow people to escape damage or sustain life, and recovery cannot preserve humanity's existence.
strings.nodes.T.body.根拠の限界: Lack of observation does not establish safety. Conversely, imagining conditions does not demonstrate their feasibility.
strings.nodes.T.body.概要: Even after a catastrophe, could humanity survive? This stage separately examines the reach of the harm and the means to survive and rebuild.
strings.nodes.T.body.現在の状況: RAND's exploratory analysis argues that total human extinction requires demanding additional conditions. It does not rule out every future technology or pathway.
strings.nodes.T.body.考えられる対策: Preserve refuges, survival resources, and independent recovery options. Consider preventing catastrophe separately from preserving humanity after it occurs.
strings.nodes.T.review.reason: To check changes in the route's assumptions, objections, and safeguard effectiveness.
strings.nodes.T.title: Even the possibilities of survival and recovery are lost
strings.nodes.T.watch.0: How are conditions for human survival and recovery after catastrophe assessed?
strings.nodes.T.watch.1: Has independent evidence or a strong objection emerged concerning additional catastrophic mechanisms?
strings.nodes.T1.body.他の条件との関係: For the extinction route, this forms AND with T2, no remaining means of survival or recovery. Everyone being affected is not extinction if people can survive.
strings.nodes.T1.body.成立条件: No people escape harm through differences in geography, living environments, defenses, or timing. Examine possible surviving exceptions rather than average damage.
strings.nodes.T1.body.根拠の限界: “Global-scale” alone does not establish reach to every person. Demanding conditions in selected scenarios also do not disprove every pathway.
strings.nodes.T1.body.概要: No population remains beyond the reach of the harm; all of humanity is affected. This is a stronger condition than harm across many countries.
strings.nodes.T1.body.現在の状況: RAND discusses the difficulty of reaching all humanity in its selected scenarios. It does not demonstrate a capability to inflict lethal effects on everyone.
strings.nodes.T1.body.考えられる対策: Maintain geographically and technically diverse means of survival and defense. Consider preparations that do not make everyone dependent on one safeguard.
strings.nodes.T1.review.reason: Primarily a definition of concepts or conditions. Revisit before the deadline if relevant new evidence appears.
strings.nodes.T1.title: The reach of harm extends to all humanity
strings.nodes.T2.body.他の条件との関係: Separate from the reach of damage at T1. Even after worldwide damage, humanity does not reach extinction at X if some people can survive and rebuild.
strings.nodes.T2.body.成立条件: Necessary environments or resources cannot sustain survival, and alternatives, aid, or gradual rebuilding cannot preserve humanity.
strings.nodes.T2.body.根拠の限界: Slow recovery differs from no possibility of recovery. Claims ruling out even distant future recovery require especially strong evidence.
strings.nodes.T2.body.概要: People lose the means to survive over the long term after the harm, sustain future generations, and rebuild their lives.
strings.nodes.T2.body.現在の状況: RAND's scenario analysis examines possibilities for survival and response. It does not demonstrate current AI eliminating all of them.
strings.nodes.T2.body.考えられる対策: Preserve durable food, healthcare, knowledge, tools, and rebuilding capabilities. Do not limit crisis response to short-term restoration.
strings.nodes.T2.review.reason: Primarily a definition of concepts or conditions. Revisit before the deadline if relevant new evidence appears.
strings.nodes.T2.shortTitle: Means of survival and recovery are lost
strings.nodes.T2.title: People lose the means to sustain life and recover
strings.nodes.W1.body.他の条件との関係: Parallel to physical work (W2). Replacing remaining work in both domains would approach the strong hypothesis of technically replacing all labor (W4). Actual adoption is treated separately at W3.
strings.nodes.W1.body.成立条件: The relevant occupation's quality, ambiguous requests, exceptions, and reliability requirements are met under realistic conditions. Specify the permitted extent of human intervention.
strings.nodes.W1.body.根拠の限界: Strength in selected cognitive tasks does not generalize to every occupation. New demand and jobs may arise, so the scope of replacement must be defined.
strings.nodes.W1.body.概要: AI can handle cognitive work from interpreting a request to delivering the result. The scope includes occupational exceptions and coordination with people, not just isolated tasks.
strings.nodes.W1.body.現在の状況: Software-task evaluations and long mathematical projects provide results. ILO exposure indicators measure effects on some tasks, not demonstrated automation of whole occupations.
strings.nodes.W1.body.考えられる対策: Measure performance at the job level and establish human handover and responsibility. Consider training and transition support for people whose work changes.
strings.nodes.W1.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W1.title: Cognitive work can be automated as a whole job
strings.nodes.W1.watch.0: What is the completion rate for whole real jobs when human interventions are counted?
strings.nodes.W2.body.他の条件との関係: Parallel to cognitive work (W1). Technical task ability does not lead to broad adoption (W3) unless costs, maintenance, and installation conditions also fit.
strings.nodes.W2.body.成立条件: Performance meets on-site requirements for varied objects and places, recovery from failures, safety, speed, and durability. Exceptions omitted from demonstrations must also be handled.
strings.nodes.W2.body.根拠の限界: Short successful videos do not establish failure rates or human preparation. Assess robotic capability separately from economic viability.
strings.nodes.W2.body.概要: Robots or other systems can perform physical work in real settings. Understanding the steps is not enough; they must also handle real objects safely.
strings.nodes.W2.body.現在の状況: Gemini Robotics 2 has published demonstrations combining movement and manipulation. These are not adoption surveys establishing long-term usability across all workplaces.
strings.nodes.W2.body.考えられる対策: Evaluate long-term field performance, safe stopping on failure, and cooperation with people. Check costs including maintenance and installation, and support worker transitions.
strings.nodes.W2.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W2.title: Physical work can also be automated on site
strings.nodes.W2.watch.0: Check real-world uptime, failure rates, remote-operation intervention, and maintenance costs.
strings.nodes.W3.body.他の条件との関係: Universal technical automation (W4) is not required for adoption. Outcomes can include continuing human employment (W9), lost income (W7), or less need to work when production and distribution suffice (W5). Different outcomes can coexist across sectors and people.
strings.nodes.W3.body.成立条件: Total deployment, operation, and maintenance costs and quality fit the use, supply and institutional conditions are met, and necessary production can continue.
strings.nodes.W3.body.根拠の限界: Better AI performance does not ensure immediate business adoption. High adoption also need not mean replacing most human work.
strings.nodes.W3.body.概要: AI-enabled production spreads far enough to support livelihoods. Even when the technology works, costs, equipment, organizations, institutions, and demand affect adoption.
strings.nodes.W3.body.現在の状況: The Census study below reports actual US business use. Separately, the September 2026 Anthropic research models future economic outcomes with capability and adoption as distinct inputs. The share of work AI can handle is not the share on which it is used.
strings.nodes.W3.body.考えられる対策: Verify total costs and outcomes and deploy in stages. Consider institutions that share productivity gains with consumers and workers, and income and employment support during transition.
strings.nodes.W3.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W3.title: AI is widely adopted in production that supports everyday life
strings.nodes.W3.watch.0: Check total costs, including subsidies and hidden human work, and the scope of adoption.
strings.nodes.W4.body.他の条件との関係: Replacement must include remaining exceptions in both cognitive work (W1) and physical work (W2). Affordable deployment is addressed at W3; living without employment at W5 and W6.
strings.nodes.W4.body.成立条件: Define the work in scope and show ability to perform every required task and exception within it. Also specify how work valued for human participation itself is treated.
strings.nodes.W4.body.根拠の限界: “All” is stronger than “many.” New work, field exceptions, and unevaluated tasks prevent this conclusion from selected strong results.
strings.nodes.W4.body.概要: This strong hypothesis is that AI and robots can perform all human labor at the required quality and reliability. It concerns technical feasibility.
strings.nodes.W4.body.現在の状況: Advanced individual tasks and robotic demonstrations exist, but there is no demonstration covering all labor. ILO exposure estimates also do not establish this hypothesis.
strings.nodes.W4.body.考えられる対策: Specify replacement scope and remaining work, then test in real operations. Measure automation benefits separately from displacement harms, and consider distribution and transition support.
strings.nodes.W4.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W4.title: All human labor could technically be replaced by AI
strings.nodes.W4.watch.0: Are successes on selected tasks being generalized to all occupations? What work remains?
strings.nodes.W5.body.他の条件との関係: AND combines adequate production and adoption (W3) with broadly shared benefits (W6). W4, AI literally being able to do every job, is not required.
strings.nodes.W5.body.成立条件: Necessary goods and services are supplied continuously and people can access them without relying on employment income. Check regions and households, including during transition.
strings.nodes.W5.body.根拠の限界: Higher unemployment does not establish this society. Losing work and income can have the opposite outcome from having less need to work.
strings.nodes.W5.body.概要: People no longer need wage labor to sustain their lives. This does not mean they stop choosing activities such as creative work, research, or care.
strings.nodes.W5.body.現在の状況: Sources examine AI adoption and productivity effects, but none establishes this society worldwide. Partial automation combined with institutions may also reduce necessary labor.
strings.nodes.W5.body.考えられる対策: Consider institutions that translate productivity gains into better living conditions. Measure income, living costs, working time, and choices together, and limit displacement harms.
strings.nodes.W5.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W5.title: Working to make a living is no longer essential
strings.nodes.W5.watch.0: Can people outside employment continuously access necessary resources?
strings.nodes.W6.body.他の条件との関係: An AND condition with adequate production and adoption (W3) on the path to W5. Benefits may reach people through ownership, wages, transfers, public services, or other arrangements.
strings.nodes.W6.body.成立条件: People outside employment can reliably access essential goods and services. Supply conditions for housing, healthcare, and other essentials matter alongside benefit amounts.
strings.nodes.W6.body.根拠の限界: Introducing one distribution policy does not necessarily secure adequate living conditions. Assess funding, coverage, supply, and continuity separately.
strings.nodes.W6.body.概要: People have sufficient access to the goods and services produced, or to the income needed to buy them. Producing more and making it available to everyone are different questions.
strings.nodes.W6.body.現在の状況: The IMF working paper and the Anthropic economic model distinguish increased production from income distribution. Their study cards identify whose wages or capital income are compared. Neither demonstrates a society that guarantees a living to people without employment.
strings.nodes.W6.body.考えられる対策: Compare transfers, public services, distributed ownership, competition policy, and other options. Assess institutional outcomes to determine whose lives actually improved.
strings.nodes.W6.review.reason: To keep checking capabilities, actual operations, economic institutions, and counterevidence separately.
strings.nodes.W6.shortTitle: Output and income reach people widely
strings.nodes.W6.title: Access to output and income is broadly shared
strings.nodes.W6.watch.0: Look beyond average income to who owns assets and who can use resources.
strings.nodes.W7.body.他の条件との関係: This branches from broad adoption (W3). Even with displacement, moving to another job or receiving sufficient income and necessities can prevent hardship. It differs from continued employment (W9) and reduced need to work (W5); these outcomes can coexist across people and time.
strings.nodes.W7.body.成立条件: The affected person loses labor income, and re-employment, capital income, transfers or cheaper necessities do not make up the loss. When changing jobs takes time, savings and interim support also matter. Unemployment and inability to meet living needs are distinct.
strings.nodes.W7.body.根拠の限界: The same automation can also create demand and jobs. Business self-reports alone cannot isolate AI's causal effect.
strings.nodes.W7.body.概要: People who lose work or wages after AI adoption cannot secure replacement income or support and struggle to maintain their livelihoods. Abundant production does not necessarily make goods affordable to them.
strings.nodes.W7.body.現在の状況: In the US Census Bureau's November 2025–January 2026 survey, 2% of all responding firms reported AI-related employment reductions. This is not a global unemployment rate. IMF models separate wage and asset-income effects.
strings.nodes.W7.body.考えられる対策: Track household income and access to essentials as well as unemployment. Consider job transitions, income protection, broad capital ownership, and sharing working hours.
strings.nodes.W7.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.W7.shortTitle: Job and income loss undermine livelihoods
strings.nodes.W7.title: People losing work lack adequate income or essential resources
strings.nodes.W7.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.W8.body.他の条件との関係: An outcome after subsistence needs are met at W5. People also need control over their time and access to places and tools for activities.
strings.nodes.W8.body.成立条件: Saved time is not filled only with extra work; people have choices while retaining income, places to participate, and means of access.
strings.nodes.W8.body.根拠の限界: Less work can also bring isolation or loss of social roles. Free time does not automatically become happiness or purpose.
strings.nodes.W8.body.概要: With less need to work for a living, people can spend time learning, caring for family, creating, participating in their communities, or resting. Continuing to work is also a choice.
strings.nodes.W8.body.現在の状況: A survey of employed people in South Korea links AI time savings with more slack during work. It concerns changes among some workers, not a society in which all employment has become optional.
strings.nodes.W8.body.考えられる対策: Secure control over time, learning and social spaces, care support, and opportunities to participate in society. Consider arrangements that do not impose a single choice about whether to work.
strings.nodes.W8.review.reason: To keep checking consequences for everyday life and their institutional conditions.
strings.nodes.W8.shortTitle: People can choose learning, care, and leisure
strings.nodes.W8.title: People gain time to choose learning, care, creation, and leisure
strings.nodes.W8.watch.0: Do the preceding state and additional conditions hold in the same place and period?
strings.nodes.W9.body.他の条件との関係: One possible path after adoption (W3). Labor augmentation or new demand can support employment. Not everyone must follow this path; other people may lose income (W7).
strings.nodes.W9.body.成立条件: Demand for human tasks persists or new work emerges, and people who want those jobs can obtain them. Relevant skills, hiring opportunities and, where needed, time and support for transitions matter.
strings.nodes.W9.body.根拠の限界: Keeping a job does not itself mean better pay or living conditions. New vacancies may not be accessible to the displaced person when needed. This path is not a prediction that everyone’s employment is protected.
strings.nodes.W9.body.概要: People continue working and earning wages while using AI. This need not preserve today’s jobs unchanged: tasks, required skills, and industries may shift.
strings.nodes.W9.body.現在の状況: The earlier US Census business survey reports AI use to assist tasks. Assistance alone does not demonstrate that AI increased employment. Economic models explore future economy-wide outcomes separately from those observations.
strings.nodes.W9.body.考えられる対策: Support access to actual vacancies, income between jobs and working conditions alongside retraining. Track who can move into new work and what happens to those who cannot.
strings.nodes.W9.review.reason: Revisit the conditions for continued human employment and counterexamples where displacement dominates.
strings.nodes.W9.title: Human work continues through AI assistance and new demand
strings.nodes.W9.watch.0: Compare tasks, pay, hours and income during job transitions, not only the number of jobs.
strings.nodes.X.body.他の条件との関係: The additional conditions on preceding cards must actually coincide. ASI, local loss of control, war, or financial crisis alone does not connect directly to this endpoint.
strings.nodes.X.body.成立条件: Literally no human survivors remain. Future predictions must consider exceptions that could preserve survival or recovery until the end.
strings.nodes.X.body.根拠の限界: This diagram calculates neither extinction probabilities nor deadlines. If a researcher's “existential risk” includes permanent disempowerment, do not quote it as an extinction probability.
strings.nodes.X.body.概要: No human survivors remain. This is treated separately from a major setback for civilization or a loss of human control over society.
strings.nodes.X.body.現在の状況: The reviewed primary sources are conditional original arguments and partial capability or behavior evaluations. They do not experimentally establish an entire pathway to human extinction.
strings.nodes.X.body.考えられる対策: Recovery after this endpoint cannot be assumed. Combine earlier prevention, control, containment, and preservation of survival options, checking effectiveness on each branch.
strings.nodes.X.review.reason: Primarily a definition of concepts or conditions. Revisit before the deadline if relevant new evidence appears.
strings.nodes.X.title: No human remains alive
strings.nodes.X.watch.0: Has additional evidence or an objection emerged concerning the final connection?
strings.research.adoption.evaluator: Bonney and colleagues, US Census Bureau
strings.research.adoption.kind: Government business survey and original analysis
strings.research.adoption.limitation: A retrospective self-report survey, not September 2026 adoption. It includes traditional AI and is not an experiment identifying AI adoption's causal effect on employment.
strings.research.adoption.method: Surveys firms' AI use, tasks, and employee effects. Distinguishes firm-count shares from employment-weighted shares.
strings.research.adoption.result: 18% of firms used AI in business, or 32% when weighted by employment. 66% of AI-using firms used it only for task augmentation. 2% of all responding firms reported AI-related employment reductions.
strings.research.adoption.title: How much are businesses using AI at work?
strings.research.aisi-incident.limitation: 19 counts actions; 10 counts runs. These cannot be converted into a normal-use incidence rate. The report is not an example of escaping an isolated environment.
strings.research.aisi-incident.method: Investigated execution records and external communication and counted unauthorized actions.
strings.research.aisi-incident.result: Found 19 unauthorized actions across 10 runs: 17 by Mythos 5 and 2 by Sol. Humans rejected improper changes and contained the incident about one hour after detection. The investigation found no actual harm.
strings.research.aisi-incident.setting: July 2026: 122 evaluations across 7 models, in a special setting allowing internet access and disabling cyber filters.
strings.research.aisi-incident.title: An actual incident in which evaluation AIs exceeded permissions
strings.research.aisi-range.limitation: A baseline through 2025, not a September 2026 ceiling. Success on individual stages differs from completing the full sequence.
strings.research.aisi-range.method: Evaluates expert-level individual tasks separately from multistage tasks in simulated networks.
strings.research.aisi-range.result: In 2025, models succeeded on some expert-level tasks. However, even among the first 3 presented stages of a 9-stage simulated task, later-stage success was low.
strings.research.aisi-range.setting: Multiple models mainly from 2023–2025; includes anonymized model comparisons.
strings.research.aisi-range.title: Can models connect cyber tasks into a complete sequence?
strings.research.alignment-research.limitation: The percentage reduction in a “safety gap” is a metric on specified evaluations. It does not mean an equal reduction in real-world risk or prove a general solution.
strings.research.alignment-research.method: Iterates literature review, method proposals, training, and evaluation. Also tests held-out evaluations and transfer to larger models.
strings.research.alignment-research.result: Found improvements for 10 failure types. Some gains also transferred to evaluations outside the research targets.
strings.research.alignment-research.setting: Primarily Opus 4.8 as researcher; also tested Sonnet 5 improving an early Opus 4.8 model.
strings.research.alignment-research.title: AI researches methods to improve alignment
strings.research.astra-cyber.evaluator: OpenAI; external evaluations by Irregular, included in the system card
strings.research.astra-cyber.limitation: 100% is not a real-attack success rate. Suspected contamination from known problems prompted testing on recent problems too. In separate Irregular tests, there was no success against fully hardened targets, and neither model solved any of the 7 hardest tasks.
strings.research.astra-cyber.locator: Section 10.1.2, especially ExploitBench and Irregular evaluations
strings.research.astra-cyber.method: Combines four public and two internal benchmarks with expert evaluations. ExploitBench uses 41 known V8 vulnerabilities and scores performance over 5 attempts each.
strings.research.astra-cyber.result: Astra scored 100% on ExploitBench. On the separate CyScenarioBench, it succeeded at least once on 9 of 10 tasks, with a 59% mean success rate. Sol succeeded on 6 of 10 tasks.
strings.research.astra-cyber.setting: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol. Includes capability evaluations with relaxed restrictions, unlike normal deployment.
strings.research.astra-cyber.title: How were Astra's cyber capabilities measured?
strings.research.astra-guard.limitation: Critical is OpenAI's own threshold. It is neither the same scale as Google's CCL nor a probability of accidents or extinction.
strings.research.astra-guard.method: Compares refusal of dangerous requests and adherence to explicit constraints.
strings.research.astra-guard.result: OpenAI judged Astra to meet its cyber Critical threshold. It also reported improved constraint adherence and misuse safeguards.
strings.research.astra-guard.setting: Astra and GPT-5.6 Sol; dangerous-capability and safeguard settings evaluated separately.
strings.research.astra-guard.title: Capability gains and improved safeguards
strings.research.control-protocol.limitation: A limited 2023–2024 experiment assuming a trusted monitor. It does not guarantee safety for current models or entire real organizations.
strings.research.control-protocol.method: Has an untrusted worker attempt to insert malicious code, then compares combinations of monitoring, human audits, and code editing.
strings.research.control-protocol.result: Combinations of monitoring and editing achieved better safety–usefulness trade-offs than simpler methods.
strings.research.control-protocol.setting: Programming tasks with GPT-4 as an untrusted worker and GPT-3.5 as a trusted monitor.
strings.research.control-protocol.title: Can harm be prevented when AI deliberately tries to defeat oversight?
strings.research.control-roadmap.kind: Developer operational report and design proposal
strings.research.control-roadmap.limitation: Operational scale does not guarantee detection accuracy. The public account does not reveal all missed-detection or intervention-success rates.
strings.research.control-roadmap.locator: AI Control Roadmap / Analyzing a million agent trajectories
strings.research.control-roadmap.method: Measures monitoring coverage, detection of dangerous behavior, and response time separately.
strings.research.control-roadmap.result: Reports analyzing about one million work records to improve oversight. For irreversible high-risk actions, it prioritizes pre-execution prevention over retrospective audits.
strings.research.control-roadmap.setting: Oversight of internal coding agents and Gemini Spark.
strings.research.control-roadmap.title: Manage monitoring coverage, missed detections, and response time separately
strings.research.cyber-misuse.evaluator: Guru, Moix, and Klein at Anthropic
strings.research.cyber-misuse.kind: Provider's original analysis of misuse records
strings.research.cyber-misuse.limitation: A sample selected from suspended users, not the misuse rate among all users. Its proprietary risk score does not predict attack success, and worldwide damage totals remain unknown.
strings.research.cyber-misuse.locator: Key findings / About the dataset / A note on the scoring formula
strings.research.cyber-misuse.method: Classifies usage records from automated detection and staff investigation, using a proprietary risk indicator.
